en: The postcard shows a modernist concrete restaurant building with large glass windows and a wide outdoor terrace lined with tables and chairs. A broad exterior staircase leads up to the terrace. On top of the building is the sign "MISINA" in stylized letters. A tall concrete tower structure is visible behind the restaurant. In the foreground there is a curved road, a streetlamp, some parked cars, and a parking sign indicating 150 meters. The reverse side is a standard unused postcard layout with multilingual description and publisher information printed along the left and center.
